about: The cast, generated with PixelLab (tools/pixellab.mjs). Art direction: Xenogears-era field sprites (soft painted pixel shading, no black outlines) wearing fantasy class costumes in the manner of Granblue Fantasy's class art (steel plate with gold trim, layered cloth, capes in crimson, navy and teal).
style: JRPG field sprite in the style of Xenogears on the PlayStation: soft painterly pixel shading, no black outlines (dark lines are deep shades of the colours beside them), muted rich palette, slender anime proportions about four heads tall, ornate fantasy class costume with layered cloth and gold trim, standing relaxed.

hero.description: Tam, a young swordsman with short tousled brown hair, a teal tunic under a light steel breastplate with gold trim, a crimson scarf, dark plum trousers, brown leather boots, a longsword sheathed at the hip

elder.description: Elder Maren, an elderly woman cleric with long silver-white hair, a violet robe with gold embroidery, a white and gold mantle over her shoulders, holding a tall wooden staff topped with a gold ring

merchant.description: Odo, a cheerful stocky merchant with a short dark beard, a red cloth cap, a mustard-yellow vest over a cream shirt, a brown apron and a leather satchel

girl.description: Pip, a lively little village girl with a ginger bob, a cream blouse, a blue pinafore skirt, a green neckerchief and brown shoes

guard.description: Bram, a sturdy village guard in steel-grey plate armour with gold trim, a blue soldier's cap with a short brim, a navy cape, a round shield on his back

keeper.description: Keeper Ansel, an old lighthouse keeper with white hair and a trimmed white beard, a navy wool sea coat with brass buttons, a navy cap with a gold band, carrying a small brass lantern
